Initial release of smyx-family-conflict-intensity-detect-analysis.

- Analyzes real-time audio and video from a fixed living room camera to assess conflict intensity (low/medium/high) by detecting sound levels and aggressive body movements.
- Automatically sends gentle reminders to mobile devices when medium or high conflict intensity is detected, and can notify emergency contacts if needed.
- Generates conflict frequency reports for family counselors; supports application in homes, counseling rooms, and mediation centers.
- Integrates with smart-home cameras or health management apps to promote family harmony and self-awareness.
- Enforces secure open-id acquisition before analysis, and requires cloud-based history queries for past conflict reports.
